inherited_no_default: Inherited from the tool or from the extended configuration
unrecognized_title: Value not recognized by the form
unrecognized_lead: The form does not change or remove this value. Edit it in the text.
unsupported_title: Fields the form does not support
unsupported_lead: These keys stay as they are in the file; the form does not edit them.
unavailable_fix: Text editing is still available in the Files tab.
read_only: This file is read-only for JGates; the form only shows the values.
shared_with: Shared with {tools}: saving here does not change their sections.
unchanged: The chosen values are already in the file; nothing was written.
conflict_title: The file changed since the form was opened
conflict_lead: Another editor (or the other tool of this file) saved a new version. Nothing was written. Your changes can be reapplied on top of the current version, after you check the diff.
conflict_rebased: Your changes on the current version
conflict_rebase_failed: Your changes do not apply to the current version: {message}
